definitions.B_x: eligible co-literals b for which the pivot-involving repeated pair macro is syntactically available and its macro CNF fits the frozen cap
definitions.E_xb: exact exclusive removable resolvent mass characterized by generator intersections

lemma.statement: For k>0, max_{b in B_x} rho_xb >= (sum_b E_xb - sum_b H_xb)/k - overflow_x. Therefore if sum_b E_xb - sum_b H_xb >= k*overflow_x, at least one eligible pivot-involving pair has rho_xb>=0 and returns x under the raw N^2 cap, subject to the already-frozen exact macro verification/progress gates.
proof: For every eligible b, the exact generator-intersection identity gives rho_xb=E_xb-H_xb-overflow_x.
The maximum of finitely many values is at least their arithmetic mean.
Averaging the exact rho values yields (sum E - sum H)/k - overflow_x.
If this quantity is nonnegative, some rho_xb is nonnegative.

generator_sum_identity.statement: sum_{b in B_x} E_xb = sum_{r in R_new} (1+|r|)*|I_x(r) intersect B_x|.

universal_candidate.statement: Every reachable root-phase all-ordinary-pivot-overflow state has some root pivot orientation x with nonempty eligible B_x satisfying aggregate_relief_x := sum E_xb-sum H_xb-k*overflow_x >= 0.
universal_candidate.consequence_if_proved: L1C and hence L1 root-phase pivot-grammar totality follow.
